替换密钥文件为真正的密钥数据
但是依赖本地 ip 和证书文件是不能用的，所以执行以下命令

apiVersion: v1
clusters:
- cluster:
    certificate-authority-data: xxx
    extensions:
    - extension:
        last-update: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 12:27:27 CST
        provider: minikube.sigs.k8s.io
        version: v1.36.0
      name: cluster_info
    server: https://192.168.49.2:8443
  name: minikube
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: minikube
    extensions:
    - extension:
        last-update: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 12:27:27 CST
        provider: minikube.sigs.k8s.io
        version: v1.36.0
      name: context_info
    namespace: default
    user: minikube
  name: minikube
current-context: minikube
kind: Config
preferences: {}
users:
- name: minikube
  user:
    client-certificate-data: xxx
    client-key-data: xxx

自签名的证书，不安全，所以在调试的时候应该使用
